channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Markelle Fultz | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Markelle Fultz from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Brad Stevens on Markelle Fultz’s reemergence:

“Sometimes it’s about opportunity and he has found a great fit here.”

Brad Stevens on Markelle Fultz, Feb 5, 2020. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Steve Clifford on where PG Markelle Fultz is most effective:

“In many ways, I just think he’s a good all-around player because he has a feel for the game. He’s a terrific passer and his ability to get into the paint and have a feel for where everybody is is very unique.”

Steve Clifford on Markelle Fultz, Nov 5, 2019. Source: Twitter @osroyparry.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Magic coach Steve Clifford on what he's seeing from PG Markelle Fultz:

“He takes what you work on fundamentally and he immediately applies it when they play 5-on-5. It’s a great trait to have. Most of the good older players are able to do that, but he’s very, very bright.”

Steve Clifford on Markelle Fultz, Oct 3, 2019. Source: Twitter @osroyparry.

item.title: Jonathan Isaac on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Roy Parry:Jonathan Isaac on the practice debut of Markelle Fultz:

“I thought he looked fantastic...his ability to get into the lane, his ability to just be crafty, and already able to manipulate the offense in a way that he wants and he's just learning it. I definitely saw that...”

Jonathan Isaac on Markelle Fultz, Oct 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @osroyparry.

item.title: Jeff Weltman on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Asked what reports the Magic have received about Fultz’s ability to shoot without pain, Weltman responded,

“We have to get him in here, and we have to get our arms around him. We have to see for ourselves. I really think that anything that you don’t experience yourself is just speculation. We have to get our own people working with him and understanding what’s going on. I have full confidence in our coaches, in our performance staff, in our support staff to give Markelle everything he needs to succeed here.”

Jeff Weltman on Markelle Fultz, Feb 8, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Jeff Weltman on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Magic president of basketball operationsJeff Weltman said tonight:

“Markelle Fultz was the number-one pick in the draft two years ago, and it wasn't a fluke. I think the whole league had him there. So we believe that, at 20 years old, the sky's the limit for him.”

Jeff Weltman on Markelle Fultz, Feb 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @JoshuaBRobbins.

item.title: Jeff Weltman on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
More @Orlando Magic President of Basketball OperationsJeff Weltman on trading for Markelle Fultz:

“We will provide Markelle with the best possible support at his own pace and look forward to his future contributions.”

Jeff Weltman on Markelle Fultz, Feb 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.

item.title: Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Jon Johnson:Brett Brown on adjustments based on Fultz situation:

“My initial reaction is, we can adsorb this because we have TJ.”

Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Nov 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @jonjohnsonwip.

item.title: Raymond Brothers on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
In a phone conversation with PhillyVoice conducted Thursday afternoon,Fultz’s agent, Raymond Brothers, vehemently denied the allegation.

“Markelle and the motorcycle, I saw the article that was sent, 100 percent not true,”

Raymond Brothers on Markelle Fultz, Nov 15, 2018. Source: Philly Voice.

item.title: Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
“Look at what he does now when he doesn't get in the game. He is Markelle Fultz's biggest fan …He has sacrificed in order to allow us, allowing me to coach Markelle Fultz and try to grow him. But from a human standpoint, it is disappointing.”

Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Nov 4, 2018. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz:

“Let’s look at him as a 20-year-old talent instead of the first player chosen. There’s going to be ups and downs.”

Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Oct 16, 2018. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
“I'm not close to everyone that was there but it just happened naturally with Markelle. You sit on the bus together, you start talking, and find something in common.”

Jayson Tatum on Markelle Fultz, Oct 6, 2018. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
#Sixers center@Joel Embiid on @Markelle Fultz:

“I think he's going to show everybody why he was the No. 1 pick.”

Joel Embiid on Markelle Fultz, Sep 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.

item.title: Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
“At some point, it will sure help. But I have aspirations, ambitions for him where I want him to feature on an all-defensive team. I personally want to post him more. I look forward to using him as a screener and giving Markelle the ball and let him roll out of it, that Blake Griffin-sort of half-roll and go to dunk.”

Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Sep 18, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Jon Johnson:Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz's new aggressiveness to shoot:

“When I see him now come back into our gym. You look at his swagger, his cocky side, his mojo, he's seeking shots. He really is not bashful.”

Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Sep 18, 2018. Source: Twitter @jonjohnsonwip.

item.title: JJ Redick on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
JJ Redick:

“I think Markelle, by all accounts that I’ve heard both externally and internally from the Sixers, he has progress, he is in a good state mentally and physically,he is going to have a fantastic season.”

JJ Redick on Markelle Fultz, Jul 26, 2018. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
#Sixers coachBrett Brown on @Markelle Fultz:

“I feel just so excited to see him play #NBA basketball and show why he was the first player chosen in the NBA draft.”

Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Jul 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.

item.title: Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
#Sixers coach and interim general manger Brett Brown on @Markelle Fultz:

“I have tremendous confidence that he’s going to have a hell of a year this year.”

Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Jul 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.

item.title: Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz:

“I have tremendous optimism and confidence that he’s going to have a hell of a year next year. I believe that completely and just really excited to see him with us and bring him back into our program on a full-time basis.”

Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Jul 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @JessicaCamerato.

item.title: Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Bryan Colangelo
item.description:
Brett Brown on the report that Colangelo overruled others in the front office with his Fultz selection:

“That is untrue. There was a collaborative decision on Markelle, and we’re still happy that decision was made … Time will tell, but I’ve got belief in Markelle Fultz.”

Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Bryan Colangelo, Jun 16, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Julius Erving on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Sixers legend and Hall of Famer Julius Erving saidThursday morning on ESPN’s Get Up.

“He was there. I guess there was just, it was all about fit. And we took Fultz, Philly took Fultz.”

Julius Erving on Markelle Fultz, May 3, 2018. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Julius Erving on Ben Simmons, Markelle Fultz, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
After showering Simmons with some praise, Erving set his sights on the rookie scorer.

“Tatum probably should have been the first pick in the draft. He was there, I guess there was just, it was all about the fit. And we took Fultz, Philly took Fultz, and obviously Fultz's whole rookie year — I think he'll be a rookie again next year sorta like Simmons because of the injuries,”

Julius Erving on Ben Simmons, Markelle Fultz, Jayson Tatum, May 3, 2018. Source: Philly Voice.

item.title: TJ McConnell on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
“Markelle is a special player and he deserves to be out there. I just have to continue to stay ready and be a professional to the best of my abilities.”

TJ McConnell on Markelle Fultz, Apr 8, 2018. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz's return:

“He's put in a lot of work. I'm thrilled to be able to offer him the opportunity to come join his teammates at this exciting time of the year.”

Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Mar 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Bryan Colangelo on Markelle Fultz:

“There’s always a chance that he’s going to be out there soon, and there’s a chance that he’s not going to play this year. I can’t answer that question because we don’t know the answer to that.”

Bryan Colangelo on Markelle Fultz, Feb 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @JCameratoNBCS.

item.title: Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz's shoulder:

“I don't know if we could say it's 100%, the doctors could say that better than me, but it certainly is getting better.”

Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Jan 14, 2018. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Frank Ntilikina on Markelle Fultz, Dennis Smith
item.description:
As LeBron James so eloquently pointed out, Knicks president Phil Jackson bypassed Smith at No. 8 for Ntilikina, who is excelling most on defense.

“Me and Frank are actually cool,’’ Smith told The Post on Friday in New Orleans. “At the draft — I’ve been playing with a lot of those draft guys since middle school — but I probably talked to Frank more than anybody else other than Markelle Fultz, then at the rookie photo shoot, too. Frank and I are cool.”

Frank Ntilikina on Markelle Fultz, Dennis Smith, Dec 31, 2017. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Ben Simmons on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
#Sixers@Ben Simmons on @Markelle Fultz:

“I know he wants to get out there. He can't wait. I'm looking forward to playing with him just because the start of the season, you could see a lot of potential with him. I think we're going to have a great chemistry once he gets back.”

Ben Simmons on Markelle Fultz, Dec 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
“I don’t know what prompted the comment by the agent to the report last night. We did have a communication about it after that. But again, there’s a lot of things that go into the noise that’s out there. Again, we are trying to do the best for Markelle and by Markelle to put him in a position to succeed.”

Bryan Colangelo on Markelle Fultz, Oct 25, 2017. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Raymond Brothers on Markelle Fultz
item.description:
agent Raymond Brothers told ESPN.

“He literally cannot raise up his arms to shoot the basketball. He decided to try and fight through the pain to help the team. He has a great attitude. We are committed to finding a solution to get Markelle back to 100 percent.”

Raymond Brothers on Markelle Fultz, Oct 24, 2017. Source: ESPN.
